the construction of a series of M13 bacteriophage expression vectors in which the beta-gal gene has been modified in order to facilitate insertion of a DNA segment in the correct phase for expression of the foreign gene product.
the construction of a series of M13 bacteriophage cloning vectors, each of which contains a unique restriction endonuclease site in phase with the initiation codon for translation of the lacZ gene.
the development of a set of vectors for the expression, in Escherichi a coli, of foreign proteins, and the application of these vectors to the expression of the rabies virus glycoprotein.
